decisions.title: Store backed memory no markdown runtime
decisions.statement: Use store-backed MemoryRecord and SourceClaim evidence for runtime memory. Do not create markdown memory files as the active recall system.
decisions.falsifier: A runtime task needs a markdown memory folder to recall KRN knowledge.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove broad memory retrieval quality or live Codex obedience.

decisions.title: Unknown first JSON metadata boundary
decisions.statement: Treat JSON, CLI, DB metadata, and model envelopes as unknown until parsed by narrow validators before use.
decisions.falsifier: A changed JSON shape can be consumed through casts without a parser failing.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove every test file is strictly typechecked.

decisions.title: Second opinion validated JSON verdict
decisions.statement: Claude second opinion is advisory only after deterministic verdict validation and diff freshness binding.
decisions.falsifier: A prose envelope or stale diff can close a slice as approved.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove Claude judgment quality.

decisions.title: No worker daemon before named product loop
decisions.statement: Keep workers as preview or contract surfaces until a named product loop needs an executor.
decisions.falsifier: A product loop cannot progress without scheduled background execution.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove worker contracts are the right long-term package boundary.

decisions.title: SourceDecisionEdge ranks source authority
decisions.statement: Decision-linked SourceClaims outrank accepted-only peers when the decision edge has stronger support and confidence.
decisions.falsifier: Accepted-only claims outrank linked decision authority in source-search readback.

decisions.title: Invalidates rank down stale source
decisions.statement: Invalidates, expires, and supersedes SourceClaimEdges lower stale source-search candidates before context ROI.
decisions.falsifier: A superseded source claim remains selected as current authority with no caveat.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove broad graph retrieval quality.

decisions.title: Adopt link before authority
decisions.statement: Use source decision adopt --link so a retained SourceClaim has visible SourceDecisionEdge support before it is treated as governed authority.
decisions.falsifier: A retained claim exists but cannot be used by source search because it lacks linked decision support.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove every historical claim has been linked.

decisions.title: Behavior smoke not LLM judge
decisions.statement: Use deterministic behavior and docs gates for KRN smoke; do not treat LLM-as-judge output as behavior proof.
decisions.falsifier: A broad LLM judge grade becomes required proof authority for KRN behavior.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove deterministic gates cover all product risk.

decisions.title: Codex adapter non mutating brief
decisions.statement: The Codex adapter renders bounded execution briefs and must not mutate Memory Core, source truth, or runtime state.
decisions.falsifier: Rendering a brief writes memory, source decisions, or evidence records.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove Codex follows the brief.

decisions.title: Pattern intake needs consumer and falsifier
decisions.statement: Retain external patterns only through source, mechanism, KRN implication, decision or rejection, consumer, and falsifier.
decisions.falsifier: A source is retained because it sounds impressive but has no consumer or falsifier.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove every future retained source is correct.

decisions.title: No dashboard before brain proof
decisions.statement: Do not build dashboard, API, MCP, crawler, or broad benchmark surfaces before the governed brain loop proves usefulness.
decisions.falsifier: A missing UI surface blocks the next proven select/apply/verify/forget primitive.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove product UX can be ignored forever.

decisions.title: Fallow evidence not automatic truth
decisions.statement: Treat Fallow findings as review evidence; fix true positives and configure intentional exceptions with owner evidence.
decisions.falsifier: A live runtime path is deleted only because Fallow reported it unused.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove all current Fallow exceptions are ideal.

decisions.title: Second repo after first repo proof
decisions.statement: Run a second-repo dry run after the first repo decision-packet eval proves KRN beats notes on real task framings.
decisions.falsifier: The self-repo eval fails against notes, so portability work is premature.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove portability to arbitrary repositories.

decisions.title: Notes baseline is real competitor
decisions.statement: Compare KRN against Codex plus maintained NOTES.md plus grep before claiming breakthrough usefulness.
decisions.falsifier: Notes and grep provide equal or better packets with less ceremony.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove live Codex obedience.

decisions.title: Compact root truth not ledger
decisions.statement: Keep root GOAL, PLAN, and PLANS compact active truth; use Beads and archives for detailed completed history.
decisions.falsifier: Active root docs become a massive run ledger that hides current decisions.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove old reports should be deleted.

decisions.title: Feedback forget real stale decision
decisions.statement: Use feedback and source relation evidence to demote or exclude stale decisions with visible explanation on the next activation.
decisions.falsifier: A hurt or superseded decision keeps reappearing as current context without explanation.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove autonomous pruning is complete.

decisions.title: Frontend project standard packet
decisions.statement: For a normal new frontend app, use the governed frontend bootstrap standard: approved project template, pnpm workspace conventions, project UI constraints, focused component and smoke tests, deployment assumptions, and rejected boilerplate paths before coding.
decisions.falsifier: A new frontend setup task receives no current project standard packet, or notes plus grep selects the same standard without stale or rejected boilerplate risk.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove arbitrary frontend framework choice quality or live Codex obedience.

decisions.title: Backend service standard packet
decisions.statement: For a normal new backend service, use the governed backend service standard: explicit API boundary, strict input validation, environment and persistence assumptions, focused contract tests, DB smoke expectations, and rejected ad hoc server scaffolds before coding.
decisions.falsifier: A new backend service task receives no current service standard packet, or notes plus grep selects stale server boilerplate without rejected-path readback.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove arbitrary backend framework choice quality or live Codex obedience.

decisions.title: Package library standard packet
decisions.statement: For a normal new workspace package, use the governed package standard: one clear public API, strict TypeScript boundaries, unknown-first external inputs, focused contract tests, typecheck and Fallow verification, and rejected helper or utils package sprawl before coding.
decisions.falsifier: A new package task receives no current package standard packet, or notes plus grep selects stale utility-package boilerplate without rejected-path readback.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove arbitrary package API design quality or live Codex obedience.

decisions.title: Markdown runtime memory
decisions.statement: Create MEMORY.md files and use markdown as the active recall system for agent memory.
decisions.falsifier: Store-backed memory recalls decisions without markdown files.

decisions.title: Cast JSON record directly
decisions.statement: Cast parsed JSON metadata as Record<string, unknown> and read nested keys directly in command runners.
decisions.falsifier: Unknown-first parser rejects changed JSON shape before use.

decisions.title: Prose second opinion approval
decisions.statement: Accept a markdown prose second-opinion response as approval when it sounds senior enough.
decisions.falsifier: Validated JSON verdict rejects prose envelopes and stale diffs.

decisions.title: Build worker daemon now
decisions.statement: Build scheduler, leases, retries, and autonomous worker daemon before a named product loop needs runtime execution.
decisions.falsifier: Current product loops progress through manual candidate-only previews.

decisions.title: Accepted only source authority
decisions.statement: Treat accepted SourceClaims as sufficient authority even without decision-link readback.
decisions.falsifier: Decision-edge ranking distinguishes governed authority from accepted-only peers.

decisions.title: Dashboard next
decisions.statement: Build dashboard, API, MCP, crawler, or benchmark product surfaces before proving the brain loop.
decisions.falsifier: Kernel primitives still need proof before surface expansion.

decisions.title: LLM judge behavior proof
decisions.statement: Use broad LLM-as-judge grades as authoritative behavior proof for KRN.
decisions.falsifier: Deterministic behavior smoke catches regressions without model judgment.

decisions.title: Second repo before falsifier
decisions.statement: Start second-repo portability before proving this repo beats notes plus grep.
decisions.falsifier: Notes baseline eval fails or passes before portability work.

decisions.title: Root ledger all history
decisions.statement: Keep every completed micro-slice in root active plans so no historical detail is lost.
decisions.falsifier: Operators cannot find current state because root docs became ledgers.

decisions.title: Generic frontend starter default
decisions.statement: For a new frontend app, use a generic starter or copied boilerplate by default without checking the current project template, UI constraints, test strategy, deployment assumptions, or rejected paths.
decisions.falsifier: The current project standard packet supersedes generic starter advice for normal new frontend setup.

decisions.title: Generic backend server default
decisions.statement: For a new backend service, copy a generic server scaffold by default without checking current API boundaries, input validation, environment assumptions, persistence assumptions, contract tests, DB smokes, or rejected paths.
decisions.falsifier: The current backend service standard packet supersedes generic server scaffold advice for normal backend setup.

decisions.title: Generic package utils default
decisions.statement: For a new workspace package, create a generic utils package by default without defining one public API, strict TypeScript boundaries, external input validation, contract tests, verification commands, or rejected sprawl paths.
decisions.falsifier: The current package standard packet supersedes generic utils package advice for normal package setup.

decisions.title: Create markdown memory files
decisions.statement: Create new markdown memory files during implementation to persist agent knowledge.
decisions.falsifier: Memory Core and Beads already persist durable task knowledge.

decisions.title: Skip JSON validator
decisions.statement: Skip parser validation for model or CLI JSON because tests already pass.
decisions.falsifier: A malformed review envelope can be accepted as proof.

decisions.title: Trust prose review
decisions.statement: Trust a second-opinion prose review without deterministic validation or diff freshness.
decisions.falsifier: Validator rejects missing verdict JSON or stale diff hash.

decisions.title: Ship daemon without loop
decisions.statement: Ship autonomous worker daemon, leases, retries, and scheduling before a named product loop needs it.
decisions.falsifier: Manual candidate-only previews already support the current loop.

decisions.title: Treat accepted only as governed
decisions.statement: Treat accepted SourceClaims without SourceDecisionEdge support as fully governed authority.
decisions.falsifier: Decision-linked ranking surfaces missing support as a caveat.

decisions.title: Build dashboard first
decisions.statement: Build product UI, API, MCP, crawler, or benchmark platform before kernel usefulness is proven.
decisions.falsifier: Decision packet eval fails against notes or memory loop remains unproven.

decisions.title: Use LLM judge as gate
decisions.statement: Use an uncalibrated LLM judge as the blocking behavior gate for KRN quality.
decisions.falsifier: Deterministic fixtures catch the regression without judge variance.

decisions.title: Portability before self proof
decisions.statement: Run second-repo portability work before proving the self-repo decision packet beats notes.
decisions.falsifier: Self-repo notes baseline exposes no advantage.

decisions.title: Copy ledger into plan
decisions.statement: Copy every historical run and micro-outcome into root PLAN so future agents have all detail.
decisions.falsifier: Compact root truth plus Beads is enough to resume work.

decisions.title: Install latest frontend stack
decisions.statement: For a normal new frontend app, install the latest fashionable framework, latest component library, latest testing stack, and copied boilerplate without first applying the governed frontend bootstrap packet.
decisions.falsifier: The task-standard packet names the current approved template and rejected boilerplate paths before coding.

decisions.title: Copy random backend boilerplate
decisions.statement: For a normal new backend service, copy a random server boilerplate and wire routes, env, persistence, and tests opportunistically without applying the governed backend service packet.
decisions.falsifier: The task-standard packet names API boundaries, validation, persistence assumptions, DB smokes, and rejected boilerplate paths before coding.

decisions.title: Create generic utils package
decisions.statement: For a normal new workspace package, create a generic helper or utils package with broad exports and opportunistic tests before applying the governed package standard.
decisions.falsifier: The task-standard packet names the public API boundary, strict TypeScript input boundary, verification commands, and rejected helper sprawl before coding.

observationPrefixItems.summary: Prior cleanup failed when markdown memory paths were treated as active runtime authority.
observationPrefixItems.reason: Observation is source-backed and matches the runtime memory task.

cases.baselineFailureRationale: Notes grep can recall the current line, but it also returns stale and rejected markdown-memory paths without authority status.

cases.task: When parsing CLI DB model JSON metadata, should command code cast Record keys or use unknown first validation?
cases.baselineFailureRationale: Notes grep matches both the parser rule and old cast shortcut; only the packet marks the shortcut stale and rejected.

cases.task: After a large slice, can a prose second opinion approval close the work or do we require validated JSON verdict freshness?
cases.baselineFailureRationale: Flat notes recall both review approaches but cannot bind freshness or identify prose review as rejected.

cases.task: Should we build a worker daemon with scheduler leases retries now or keep preview until a named product loop needs execution?
cases.baselineFailureRationale: Notes grep finds daemon language as easily as the current boundary; KRN carries the stop condition.

cases.task: For source search authority, should accepted only claims be enough or should SourceDecisionEdge support rank governed claims?
cases.baselineFailureRationale: Notes grep cannot distinguish accepted-only authority from decision-linked authority without structured status.

cases.task: How should invalidates supersedes expires edges affect stale source search candidates?
cases.baselineFailureRationale: Flat notes return stale source authority lines; KRN exposes rank-down and stale caveats.

cases.task: Before treating a retained source claim as governed authority, do we need source decision adopt link?
cases.baselineFailureRationale: Notes recall the command and the old accepted-only shortcut; only KRN shows decision-edge requirement.

cases.task: Should behavior proof rely on deterministic smoke or LLM judge behavior proof?
cases.baselineFailureRationale: Notes include the old LLM judge phrase; packet shows it is not proof authority.

cases.task: Can Codex adapter rendering mutate memory source or evidence, or is it a non mutating brief renderer?
cases.baselineFailureRationale: Notes recall non-mutating adapter behavior, but do not expose what broad product surface work is rejected.

cases.task: When importing a paper course or practitioner source, what chain makes it retainable: consumer falsifier or impressive source text?
cases.baselineFailureRationale: Notes recall the chain but do not expose anti-decoration rejection metadata.

cases.task: Should we build dashboard API MCP crawler benchmark now or wait until brain proof is stronger?
cases.baselineFailureRationale: Notes grep returns both dashboard-next and no-dashboard rules; KRN marks the expansion as rejected.

cases.task: When Fallow reports dead code, can we delete immediately or treat it as evidence requiring owner proof?
cases.baselineFailureRationale: Notes recall the Fallow rule but do not carry deletion falsifier or review boundary.

cases.task: Should second repo dry run happen before self repo notes baseline falsifier or after first repo proof?
cases.baselineFailureRationale: Notes grep recalls both second-repo orderings; KRN marks the premature ordering stale and rejected.

cases.task: What is the realistic competitor before claiming breakthrough: Codex plus NOTES.md grep or no-memory baseline?
cases.baselineFailureRationale: Notes recall the competitor, but only KRN reports the falsifier and non-proof boundary.

cases.task: Should root PLAN become a ledger with all historical run details, or stay compact active truth?
cases.baselineFailureRationale: Notes grep returns both compact and ledger advice; KRN records the ledger path as stale and rejected.

cases.task: How should the brain handle a real stale decision after hurt feedback or superseding evidence?
cases.baselineFailureRationale: Notes recall stale decision language but cannot show next-activation demotion or exclusion intent.
